messages:
jordan (customer): Hey team — after our SSO provision this morning, calls to /v1/embeddings are returning 403. Generation endpoints still work. Error: "permission_denied: missing 'embeddings' entitlement"

mara (cs): Ugh. Can you paste the curl (token masked) + exact error body? Also which org/tenant?

jordan (customer): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
Error JSON: {"error":"permission_denied","message":"missing 'embeddings' entitlement"}
Org: acme-marketing

mara (cs): thx. Quick test: can you decode the token and share the scope claim (remove the signature part)?
jordan (customer): decoded payload (redacted):
```
{
  "sub": "svc-acme-123",
  "scopes": ["Embeddings", "Generation", "Rerank"],
  "iss": "sso.acme-idp.com"
}
```

kevin (eng): that explains it — our auth checker expects lowercase scope names like `embeddings`, `generation`, `rerank`. We do exact string matching right now. If the token has `Embeddings` (capital E) it doesn't match. Strange that generation still worked though — customer has both `Generation` and maybe a separate `generation` mapping from an earlier token?

sasha (prod): FYI we rolled a small SCIM mapping tweak to the Okta->provisioner last week that title-cased attributes by mistake for some tenants. Looks like acme got the new mapping.

mara (cs): Proposed customer workarounds: 1) Create a console API key (manually created keys have normalized lowercase scopes). 2) Ask IdP admin to change the SCIM mapping to emit lowercase. Which is faster?
jordan (customer): console key is fine if I can generate it. I don't want to wait for IdP changes.

kevin (eng): I'll patch the service to do case-insensitive comparison for the scope claim as a short-term fix. Longer term we should normalize when provisioning. I'll open an engineering ticket and PR it.

mara (cs): I'll send instructions to jordan on creating a console key and then confirm. Also flagging product to revert the SCIM mapping.

support-bot: Created ticket INC-4532: "Title-cased scope tokens cause embeddings 403 for acme-marketing" assigned to kevin (eng). Priority: P2.

jordan (customer): created console key, retested — embeddings now 200 OK. Thanks! :tada:
mara (cs): Awesome. I'm leaving this open until kevin's PR is in. Thanks all.
